column1: # Central definition of the HLA genes covered by a SpecHLA reference.
# Every gene listed here is built into the reference and every downstream step
# iterates over exactly this list. Editing this file (adding, removing or
# reordering genes, or changing the representative allele) is the supported way
# to change the gene content of a reference; no other file needs to be touched.
# Columns:
#   gene                   IMGT/HLA gene symbol, without the "HLA-" prefix.
#   hla_class              I or II. Controls which exons define the G group
#                          (exon 2+3 for class I, exon 2 for class II) and how
#                          many leading exons are recorded in exon_extent.bed.
#   representative_allele  Allele whose genomic sequence becomes the single
#                          record "HLA_<gene>" of hla.ref.extend.fa. If the
#                          allele is absent from the IMGT release in use, the
#                          build falls back to the first non-null four-field
#                          allele of the gene and records the substitution in
#                          BUILD_MANIFEST.json.
# gene
